info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Textile Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Textile Recliner Detail Submission API enables businesses to submit detailed information for textile recliner products to the catalog. This endpoint is primarily for manufacturers or retailers looking to enrich their product offerings with comprehensive descriptions, specifications, and images. By leveraging this API, users can ensure accurate representations of their textile recliners, facilitating better customer engagement and informed purchasing decisions. Typical use cases include onboarding new products into an existing catalog or updating current listings.

post.summary: Create a textile recliner detail entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new detail for a textile recliner. You need to provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully create the detail. Make sure to validate the input to comply with the expected format.
